paper_title: Axion-Like Particles and Recent Observations of the Cosmic Infrared Background Radiation
suggested_experiment_name: CAST (shown in CIBER ALP paper Fig. 5)
notes: Paper identifies an ALLOWED region (not exclusion) in the (m_a, g_agamma) plane that resolves the tension between CIBER CIB data and TeV gamma-ray transparency. The region spans m_a ~ 7e-10 to 5e-8 eV and g_agamma ~ 1.5e-11 to 8.8e-10 GeV^-1. Data points given are corner bounds from the text; the actual contour (Fig.5) is not numerically tabulated. This is a preferred/allowed region rather than a conventional exclusion limit, hence moderate confidence. | Vision: Figure 5 shows ALLOWED regions (closed contours) for CIBER-only and CIBER+IRTS+AKARI, not a conventional exclusion limit. The only true exclusion boundary is the horizontal CAST line at g_agamma ~ 8.8e-11 GeV^-1 (region above is excluded for m_a < 0.02 eV). The closed contours represent allowed parameter space resolving the gamma-ray transparency tension (m_a ~ 7e-10 to 5e-8 eV, g_agamma ~ 1.5e-11 to 8.8e-10 GeV^-1). Low confidence because this is not a standard exclusion plot; the extracted boundary is the CAST constraint only. | Calibration: Spot-check calibration: verify/stage2 ratio=0.2x
